card.name: Word right after a subject, before its outcome
card.fires_on: A word right after a noun subject that comes just before a predicted outcome verb, such as will, to, and, before, or break. It appears in explanations of how something fails, collapses, separates or occurs.

modes.label: Linking word after subject
modes.description: A small word like will, before, to or and follows a subject and leads into a result such as collapse or separation.
modes.example: the core<< will>> collapse causing them to buckle forward

modes.label: Inside outcome phrases
modes.description: A word partway through a process term, where the next word names an event such as breaking, swarming or occurring.
modes.example: a tendency to<< break>> along smooth planes termed slaty cleavage

modes.label: Medical term mid-phrase
modes.description: A word inside a medical noun phrase that is still being completed.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about how something manifests or occurs, such as manifested and modes.
card.plain: It fires on the small word after a subject, just before the text says what happens to it.
